decisions.reason: Reopened S04, S07 and S11. Neither the body nor the Type 8 FAQ says she never confronts anyone or simply grants verdicts. The tally in 'Where each reading strains' scores the two halves of the test separately. Repair (verify-02): it now counts five tellings with a person in them, names the two in which she concedes nothing (Vanguard, Goldman), and describes the other three concessions as what they are: a verdict on how she came across, the owners' right to set the rules, and her own blame for not tracking a manager. The mountain is excluded, the marriage is explicitly not treated as having an adversary, and infertility is not counted. Type 3 still leads at medium confidence, so the type thesis is unchanged. C88, C64, C78, C136 and type_hypothesis.discriminator say what the article says.
